description: This file defines a gettext package for internationalization, including interfaces, functions, and variables for translation and locale management.

classes.name: Gettexter
classes.description: Interface for translation and locale management, including methods for domain, language, and resource handling.

classes.name: defaultGettexter
classes.description: Struct holding current language, domain, and a Gettexter instance for default locale operations.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Gettexter instance with default language settings.

methods.name: BindLocale
methods.description: Sets the current locale using a Gettexter instance.

methods.name: SetLanguage
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the current language/locale.

methods.name: SetDomain
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the current message domain.

methods.name: Gettext
methods.description: Translates a message ID into the current language.

methods.name: Getdata
methods.description: Retrieves resource data for a given name.

methods.name: NGettext
methods.description: Handles plural translations based on count.

methods.name: DNGettext
methods.description: Plural translation within a specified domain.

methods.name: DPNGettext
methods.description: Plural contextual translation within a domain.

methods.name: DGetdata
methods.description: Retrieves resource data within a specified domain.
